C-SECTION-REGISTRY-AND-FLUSH-1-766B2DF9.Summary: Register the section sets of the spec and plan wrappers and make every other direct child an error, and repair the flush verb's two warts: the codify-only path no longer demands an unused --mint-search, and every flush success line names every annotation stamp the call wrote.

Goals.Goal: A registered-section rule for the change spec and plan. Every direct child of the C-* wrapper must be a registered section for its artifact kind; any other direct child reports change.unregistered-section as an error that names the offending tag. Enumerated registered sets are named in Constraints.

The flush verb's two warts. --mint-search is required only when the charter row is minted, and every --flush success line names every annotation stamp the call wrote (codified D<n> and taught D<n> → <path>:<section>), on both the codify-only line and the mint line.

Constraints.Constraint: Ceremony tier T2 (cross-cutting: two grammar surfaces, the lint catalog, the flush verb, and a generated document).

Registered spec sections. Required: Summary, Goals, Constraints, NonGoals, AcceptanceCriteria, AffectedAreas, VerificationIntent. Optional: Problem, Assumptions, DesignReferences, Clarifications, Replacement, ReplacementChange, Proposals, ReadAloud.

Registered plan sections. Required: IntentSummary, BaselineAssertions, TargetAssertions, DurableScope, ObservedWriteScope, ImplementationPlan. Optional: OutOfPlanScope, Clarifications, Replacement, ReplacementChange, Assumptions.

An unregistered section is an error, not a warning. The C-* wrapper is a closed schema: a stray child is the same class of defect as the missing and duplicate required sections, which are already errors. A misspelled required name (for example <ObservedWriteScopes>) then produces the missing-required error naming <ObservedWriteScope> and the unregistered-section error naming the typo, so one of the two findings names the offending bytes. No fuzzy "did you mean" matching is added; naming the tag is the remedy.

Assumptions joins the plan's optional set. The plan shape had no home for a plan-time assumption about a drive it cannot run, and the archive carries Assumptions in exactly the two teaching-increment plans (C-TEACHING-INCREMENT-1-B9D139EA and C-TEACHING-INCREMENT-2-4E28E16C); the archive is immutable, so registering it is the only option that reds neither applied artifact. What it is for: plan-time assumptions whose drive cannot be exercised until the plan's own tasks land.

Proposals and ReadAloud are registered optional spec sections. The archive population uses them (C-CALIBRATION, C-PLAN-QUALITY, both status="applied"); leaving them unregistered reds two immutable archived specs, and a rule that reds the corpus on day one is a migration, not a lint.

Replacement and ReplacementChange are registered optional sections on both kinds, and a direct C-* child of a status="superseded" wrapper is admitted as a replacement anchor. The grammar's own supersede check (replacementChangeIds) accepts all three forms, so the registered rule must not forbid a form another rule permits.

The issue code is change.unregistered-section. It lives in src/lint/catalog.ts (M-LINT-CATALOG) with an exact --explain guide (title, explanation, remediation) and resolves as classification "exact"; the check lives in src/artifact/grammar.ts (M-GRAMMAR) beside validateDirectSectionCardinality.

The registered sets are exported through GRAMMAR_INVENTORIES (SPEC_OPTIONAL_SECTIONS, PLAN_OPTIONAL_SECTIONS) and registered as two new schema shapes, change-spec-optional and change-plan-optional, so the required set stays the required set. docs/schema-reference.md is generated by bun run ./scripts/generate-schema-reference.ts and must be regenerated; validate:schema-reference moves with it.

No new exports beyond the existing barrels; GRAMMAR_INVENTORIES is already exported, so MODULE_MAP is unchanged unless a task adds an export, in which case the MODULE_MAP entry moves with it. No new test file; tests extend existing test files, so test-metrics.json's file list is unchanged.
Ceremony tier T0 is not used. The new rule is a product change to the shipped grammar and its lint surface, so a spec exists in full.

Close write set. At close this bundle flushes F304 and F305 (Pays F304 F305), so the close writes the seven record files under docs/plans/active/RM-GOVERNED-PATH/ (decisions.xml, findings.xml, findings-retired.xml, rulings.xml, rulings-retired.xml, registry.xml, registry-retired.xml), the bundleMinted payer-map fixture in scripts/validate-record-retirement.test.ts (two entries, F304 and F305), and the bundle's own archive arrival. The plan declares each in ObservedWriteScope and excludes each from every byte-invariance pathspec with a reason (the AC-NO-SRC-OTHER, AC-NO-ARCHIVE-EDIT, AC-SURFACES-UNMOVED and AC-RECORD-SIBLINGS-UNMOVED criteria).

Write scope (F136.1: every module-ownable src/ file's LINKS owner is in AffectedAreas). The files this change forces, each with its owner where it has one: src/artifact/grammar.ts (M-GRAMMAR; the registered sets, the registered-section check, and its two validateChangeArtifact calls), src/lint/catalog.ts (M-LINT-CATALOG; the exact change.unregistered-section guide), src/artifact/schema-reference.ts (M-GRAMMAR; REGISTERED_SHAPE_NAMES and SCHEMA_SHAPE_REGISTRY carry change-spec-optional and change-plan-optional), docs/schema-reference.md (generated by renderSchemaReference; no module), and scripts/validate-record-retirement.ts (no module; Goal 2). The test files forced beside them: src/artifact/grammar.test.ts, src/lint/catalog.test.ts, src/artifact/schema-reference.test.ts, src/grace-lint.test.ts (the --explain CLI tests), and scripts/validate-record-retirement.test.ts (Goal 2 tests plus the bundleMinted fixture). scripts/generate-schema-reference.ts and scripts/generate-schema-reference.test.ts do NOT change: the generator delegates to renderSchemaReference(), and its test pins check/write-mode semantics, not the rendered content. No new export is added, so MODULE_MAP does not move; no new test file is added, so test-metrics.json does not move. AffectedAreas names M-GRAMMAR and M-LINT-CATALOG, the owners of both module-ownable src/ files.

NonGoals.NonGoal: README.md is unchanged; no user-visible surface. README carries no per-lint-code inventory, and no install or CLI-usage prose changes. Owner: unchanged; no user-visible surface.
examples/ is unchanged; validated by AC-EXAMPLES-GREEN, which lints examples/polyglot and must stay green under the new rule. Owner: AC-EXAMPLES-GREEN.
No fuzzy near-miss suggestion; the error names the offending tag and the missing-required error names the intended one. Owner: unchanged; the two errors together name the defect.
No archived artifact is edited or migrated; the registered sets admit the sections already in use. Owner: unchanged; the archive is immutable.
No change to the record schema, the retire verb, or the decisions.md stub; the close's writes are the existing flush and retire path. Owner: the close's existing flush/retire path.

Driven both directions: a fully registered spec and plan report no change.unregistered-section.

AcceptanceCriteria.AC-PLAN-ASSUMPTIONS-CLEAN: A plan carrying a direct <Assumptions> section reports no change.unregistered-section, and the archived plans C-TEACHING-INCREMENT-1-B9D139EA and C-TEACHING-INCREMENT-2-4E28E16C report none.

C-SECTION-REGISTRY-AND-FLUSH-1-766B2DF9.Problem:
An unregistered top-level section in a change plan passes ngrace lint 0/0. Measured 2026-09-18 at 03af506 by the authority and re-measured 2026-09-19 at 3a1d5c6dd3df43b1d5a89723a0a627ed8c006f8a by this executor: a plan with <Bogus><Item>nothing</Item></Bogus> as a direct child of its C-* wrapper lints 0 errors / 0 warnings, and so does one with an <Assumptions> section the change-plan shape does not list. validateDirectSectionCardinality validates only the names it knows and is silent about every other direct child, so a misspelled <ObservedWriteScopes> reports "missing <ObservedWriteScope>" and nothing about the stray. No unregistered-section code exists in src/lint/catalog.ts.
The archive census that fixes the registered sets (run 2026-09-19 at 3a1d5c6 over .ngrace/changes/archive with the shipped parser; 130 spec.xml and 124 plan.xml): spec direct children are the seven required plus Problem (129), Assumptions (117), Replacement (31), Clarifications (7), DesignReferences (6), Proposals (2), ReadAloud (2); plan direct children are the six required plus Replacement (25), Assumptions (2). No other name appears. A prototype of the rule with the registered sets above reports 0 flags over the archive through the real CLI; without the archive-driven names it reports 6 (Proposals, ReadAloud, Assumptions).
The flush verb demands an unused --mint-search and under-reports its writes. Measured 2026-09-19 at 3a1d5c6dd3df43b1d5a89723a0a627ed8c006f8a by this executor on a throwaway record copy: with the chartered row already minted, --flush --change C-... --taught D...:path:section without --mint-search refuses flush-mint-search-malformed at exit 1, while the identical call with --mint-search "1 active, 0 archive" exits 0 and prints record-flush: codify-only (row C-...) naming no stamp it wrote.

Assumptions.Assumption: The archive census and the prototype flag counts are measurements at 3a1d5c6dd3df43b1d5a89723a0a627ed8c006f8a on 2026-09-19; they expire if the archive grows or a bundle archives before this one closes. The registered sets are the relation, not the counts.

The prototype drove the rule in a throwaway copy of the repository with the rule patched into src/artifact/grammar.ts, because the shipped binary does not emit change.unregistered-section yet: the copy reported 0 flags with the registered sets and 6 without, and the typo plant produced the missing-required and unregistered pair. Re-measured by the plan's target assertions after implementation.
